on_screen_text.text: Kamala Harris invites Americans to reach for a better future ‼️
"In 7 days, we have the power, each of you has the power, to turn the page and start writing the next chapter, in the most extraordinary story ever told."

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris delivers an inspirational speech, describing America as a nation big enough for all dreams and strong enough to withstand division. She encourages the audience to be fearless and imagine a future of possibilities. She says, "In 7 days, we have the power, each of you has the power, to turn the page and start writing the next chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told." She concludes by asking God to bless the United States of America, to which the crowd cheers loudly.

intended_effect: To inspire viewers with a message of hope and empowerment, and to motivate them to take action in the near future.
